name: Piece of a note (Part 1)
description:
May 28th 1527
I've known Juan de Ojeda for over twenty years now. We battled side by side in our home town of Cuenca against the ever existent hunger, we fought on the way to New Spain against the ...

name: Piece of a note (Part 2)

name: Personal profile
description:
Hello little brother,
I was just about to start a big deal with a few good friends. But the Sheriff caught me during the last deal and now I'm stuck in jail in Yuma. You have to take care of the deal for me, little brother! In the Coyote desert near Capura someone will be waiting for me during the next five business days. Take care bro. Don't mess it up!
Your brother Jeremy

name: Letter from a foreign person
description:
Dear stranger,
If you hold this letter in your hands, I am probably already dead. I am guarding a book that should never go public. It contains answers to the most important secrets of our time, including the meaning of praying, the sequel of The Myth and the reason for the strange appearance of sheep and chickens in the most impossible places. In the wrong hands, these truths could cause big disasters and threaten peace in our beloved country. I do not have much time to live anymore and therefore I have to make sure that these secrets are kept safe in the future. I can not trust everyone, I have to be sure that my successor is trustworthy, unbribable, strong enough to face even the biggest challenges and as wise as he knows the Wild West like the back of his hand. If you have managed to open this chest, that is a pretty good sign. But it is not enough. In this chest, you will find everything you need in your further way. At the end of it, you will find the book of secrets whose new guardian you will become.
Your journey will not be easy. If you reach a point where you don't know how to continue, speak to Manitu.
Take care of yourself. Good luck.
I. G.
Keeper of the Chronicles of The West

name: Henry's brother statement
description: My brother, Henry, served me some drinks while Maya was away. He was very busy so I drank my beer at the table. When I left the counter for the last time, jewelry was still there. I can't remember anybody taking it.

name: Indian-Dancer's statement
description: Maya left her jewelry before I went to my performance. While dancing I didn't pay attention to what was happening next to the bar. I remember only Henry's brother taking beer from Henry and going back to his table. When he left, missing items still were on the counter. I think also Seth was buying something, but I'm not sure.

name: Doctor Jane's statement
description: Do you think I took that trashy jewelry? Maya's style doesn't fit me at all, but I remember something. Harper and Seth were sitting at one table discussing something. They were focused on some papers and plans. Did they drink something? Yes, they did. Seth bought beer for them. I'm sure that Harper was sitting all the time, he walks in a funny way.

name: Harper's statement
description: I was talking about building a small store with Seth, a place where he could sell his findings. We spent a few hours at the table discussing our business plan. He invited me for the meeting, so of course he was the one bringing snacks and drinks for us.

name: Seth's statement
description: Sure, I visited the Saloon yesterday evening. I had an important topic to discuss with Harper. We talked about modernizing the shop in our city. Finding treasures is not a very profitable profession. I have no money at all. It was embarrassing to ask Harper to buy me beer or two.
